terra.problem: “After a day with no time to eat” adds a duration the passage does not give.
“Nobody sits and waits on the shore” goes beyond the text, which says many people ran together, not what everyone did.
The explanation repeats that the people did not wait without adding much personality or insight.
“Home was the last place on their minds” states the people’s thoughts as fact. A quiet day for the apostles is also not established.
The explanation repeatedly restates the verse, while “that tells us a lot” does not explain what it tells us.
The explanation simply affirms the answer, quotes the verse, and says that is how Mark puts it. It adds no explanation or personality.
“Five loaves is a long way from that” compares the number of loaves with an amount of money, so the explanation’s comparison does not make sense.
The line about the size of the food is confusing and unrelated to the answer; the rest is a flat restatement of the passage.
“The shore isn’t mentioned” is too broad: the passage says Jesus stepped ashore in Mark 6:34.
The text says everyone ate and was satisfied; it does not say they walked away or describe their hunger afterward.
The explanation repeats that everyone ate and was satisfied without adding a meaningful explanation or Papa Dorin’s personality.
The passage does not state that the leftovers were greater in quantity than the starting food. It gives twelve basketfuls but does not establish the sizes needed for that comparison.
